hypotheses.reasoning: template-svc-3 restarted after a liveness probe failure, dropping capacity to 3/4. That alone should have been survivable. But notification-svc retries TemplateClient.render immediately with backoff disabled, so inbound traffic to template-svc rose to 3-4x baseline. template-svc then shed load with 503s (queue full), which caused more retries, and the gateway returned 503 once retries ran out. Because the loop feeds itself, errors are not recovering. The poison message sent to the DLQ at #17 was handled cleanly and is not related.
Losing one instance may have left too little capacity for normal load.
One malformed message was moved to the DLQ. It is very unlikely to be related.

verdict.recommendedAction: Turn on exponential backoff with jitter and a retry budget or circuit breaker in notification-svc's TemplateClient. Scale template-svc back to 4 or more instances, and look into why template-svc-3 failed its liveness probe.
